deceased_data: Not expressly regulated, but causahabientes (successors) may exercise the data subject's rights and file claims (arts. 14-16, 20)
research_exemption: Sensitive data may be processed for historical, statistical or scientific purposes with measures to suppress data subjects' identity (art. 6(e))
genetic_data: Genetic data not expressly named; sensitive data (art. 5) covers health, sex life and biometric data; processing needs explicit authorisation or art. 6 exception
pending_change: Reform bills 214/2025 and 274/2025 pending in the House; not enacted
